purpose: Immutable ARIEC61850 revision for ARSAS CI, tests, packaging, diagnostics, and release provenance. Baseline includes connected reconciliation, COMTRADE/MMS FileOpen interoperability, UTC-Time wire provenance, typed signal catalog query/coverage APIs, authoritative hybrid reporting, bounded live DataSet-directory discovery, and cross-logical-device dynamic RCB planning. PR #76 adds the engine-owned DataSet selection inventory projection so every static DataSet member remains application-visible even when an FCD/DataObject-level member has no uniquely resolved primary DataAttribute yet. Resolved primary signals remain preferred; unresolved members are preserved without inventing leaf semantics.
